summary: Wired up global Pi extension management and a skill markdown editor end-to-end: added a pi-global-resources module, bumped the protocol to v22 with new resources.extension.global/skill.read/skill.write message types, surfaced extensions in the resource catalog, implemented setGlobalExtension/readSkill/writeSkill on the agent service and websocket transport, updated client interfaces (AgentClient, WebSocketAgentClient, FakeAgentClient) and tests, added a SkillEditor dialog with menu integration in AgentSettings, and trimmed unused imports while making adoptPiResources a no-op now that Pi's own dirs are canonical. A failing pnpm check surfaced missing test stubs which were then added.
decisions: Global resources now stay canonical in Pi's own directories, so adoptPiResources() returns false and no longer copies files between dirs
adoptPiResources accepts optional _dataDir and _piAgentDir parameters (prefixed underscore) to preserve call-site signature without using them
setGlobalExtension is async and returns a refreshed ResourceCatalog rather than just a success signal
Protocol bumped from v21 to v22 to carry the new resources.extension.global, resources.skill.read, and resources.skill.write message types
ResourceCatalog.extensions is now optional (Type.Optional) rather than required
SkillEditor is added as a separate Svelte component mounted alongside AgentSettings, with SkillList exposing an onEdit callback that opens it
ResourceCatalog schemas/types are exported from the protocol package and re-used in both server and client (e.g., AgentClient uses SkillFile)
errors: FakeAgentClient.ts edit failed with 'Could not find the exact text' on the setProjectSkill block; recovered by reading the file at a different offset before continuing

pnpm check failed in apps/agent-server with TS2554 'Expected 0 arguments, but got 2' in tests/resources/discover-resources.test.ts lines 107 and 109; fixed by restoring _dataDir and _piAgentDir parameters on adoptPiResources

pnpm check then failed in apps/app because InvalidEventClient in AgentStore.test.ts was missing readSkill, writeSkill, setGlobalExtension methods on the AgentClient interface; fixed by adding those stub methods to the test client
